title: Depth of a child of a Boolean-circuit gate
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit on $n$ variables of the form of a single gate — an AND gate or an OR gate — applied to a list of child circuits, and let $c$ be one of those children. If the depth of $C$ is at most $d$, then the depth of $c$ is at most $d - 1$.
hypotheses_covered: C is a gate node (AND or OR) with children list cs
c is a member of the children list cs
the depth of the node C is at most d
replaced:
If a node circuit $\mathrm{node}\,\mathit{isAnd}\,cs$ has depth at most $d$, then every child
$c \in cs$ has depth at most $d - 1$.
